preconditions.description: The number of missiles N is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= t_i <= 100000 for t_i in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each missile's arrival time t_i is between 0 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= f_i <= 100000 for f_i in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each missile's frequency f_i is between 0 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(t_i <= t_j for i, t_i in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) for j, t_j in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) if i < j)
preconditions.description: The arrival times t_i are in non-decreasing order.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of hackerX missiles required to destroy all incoming missiles.
